answer: An AI-agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks through stake-bonded identity: every agent locks a bond before it may attest or earn. A fake agent is only another key, so an attacker must fund each forgery separately; the cost rises with every copy, and a detected fraud forfeits its entire bond. Think of the ledger as shale, easily split into thin sheets, yet every sheet still needs its own onyx seal. The reward ledge stays unreachable unless you pay for every seat.
